entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit Customer Support. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. You've reached VeloFit, my name is Alex. How can I help you today?
Yeah, I want to return these ridiculously expensive cycling shoes I bought. They're a complete piece of junk.
I'm sorry to hear you're not happy with your purchase. I can certainly look into that for you. Can you tell me your name and order number, please?
The name is Mark Peterson, order number is... VF8-675-309. And don't give me the runaround. I want my money back.

Thank you, Mark. I'm pulling up your order now... I see the Road Cycling Shoes, delivered 48 days ago. To make sure I understand, what specifically is the issue with them? Is it a technical fault or a preference?

What's the issue?! The issue is these so-called performance cycling shoes gave me massive blisters after a single ride! I couldn't even get the cleats to sit right. This is unacceptable! I want a full refund, and I want it now!
I understand your frustration, and I'm very sorry to hear about the blisters. That's definitely not the experience we want for our customers. Let me just check the return eligibility for you.

Check it? Don't 'check it'! Just do it! This is absurd. If you can't process my refund right now, I want to speak to your manager. I'll make sure every cycling forum online knows VeloFit sells defective products!

That won't be necessary, Mark. I've just confirmed our policy. For these cycling shoes, we have a 90-day return window. Since you received them 48 days ago, you are well within that period. I can approve a full refund for you right away.
Oh. You can? Just like that? No hassle?

Yes, of course. I apologize again for the trouble with the cleats and the discomfort they caused. I've just emailed a pre-paid return shipping label to the address on file. Just pack the shoes in any box, attach the label, and drop it off. Once our warehouse scans it in, your refund will be processed back to your original payment method.
Huh. Okay. Well, that was... surprisingly easy. Thank you, Alex.
You are very welcome, Mark. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
No, that's everything. Thanks for your help.
My pleasure. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a great day.
